title: Model Conversion
summary: This module provides functions to convert various machine learning models from their original frameworks and formats into the Hugging Face Transformers library structure. It handles weight mapping, configuration adjustments, and verification steps.

nodes.label: Conversion Utilities
nodes.title: Core Conversion Utilities
nodes.description: Provides helper functions to extract and manage weight conversion mappings for models.

nodes.label: Vision Model Converters
nodes.title: Convert Vision Models
nodes.description: Handles the conversion process for various computer vision models, adapting their weights and configurations to the Hugging Face format.

nodes.label: Text Model Converters
nodes.title: Convert Text Models
nodes.description: Manages the conversion of natural language processing models, including their tokenizer and model weights, to be compatible with Transformers.

nodes.label: Audio Model Converters
nodes.title: Convert Audio Models
nodes.description: Facilitates the conversion of speech and audio processing models, including their feature extractors and weights, for use in the Hugging Face ecosystem.

nodes.label: Multimodal Model Converters
nodes.title: Convert Multimodal Models
nodes.description: Manages the conversion of models that integrate multiple modalities (e.g., vision-language), ensuring their components are correctly adapted.

groups.label: Core Logic
groups.title: Core Conversion Logic
groups.description: Central utilities for extracting and applying model-specific conversion rules.

groups.label: Model Converters
groups.title: Model-Specific Converters
groups.description: Collection of specialized functions for converting different types of models (vision, text, audio, multimodal) into the Hugging Face format.
